items.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I know he had a tape of Thelonious Monk... I was really intrigued by it

ctx.x: So you didn’t really know who it was. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

I didn’t know who it was and I found out later, like the first one I had and listened to over and over again was Charlie Parker, Bird, you know, with the tune “Laura” and the strings and all of that. And I thought it was great but I didn’t know it was Charlie Parker. And so I was listening to that and listening to a lot of other — I know he had a tape of Thelonious Monk, and then there was a tape of some Billy Taylor playing. So I got into listening to that and I was really intrigued by it, and at the same time I…
Let me take you back for a moment. Listening to the oldies station, as you look back on that, is there anything there that you think you absorbed from that music?
